Hi Laura,

Quick context: our contract with Redwood comes up for renewal in March. As part of our internal recertification we're doing a vendor SOC2 re-attestation and need to confirm a few items before our security committee meeting next week:

- Do you have an updated SOC2 package since 2025? We need the latest attestation and the list of controls tested.
- Can you confirm your default event retention for audit logs (syslog/trace/token events)? Our security policy requires 18 months by default; current contract is 12 months.
- On the renewal side we're evaluating a capacity uplift (approx +40% token throughput) and would like to understand how that interacts with retention and egress for logs (any extra fees or technical constraints).

If easier, happy to set a 30-min sync. We need evidence (attestation PDF + a sample logs export) to present to the committee.

Hi Taylor — thanks for the heads up and the clear list. High level answers below and a proposed plan. I’m looping in Rishi (SRE/SE) for the logs/retention details and Priyom for the commercial/capacity side. Monica from CS will own evidence delivery.

Short answers:
- SOC2: we completed a Type II recertification in Nov 2026; I’ll attach the attestation package and the control matrix.
- Retention: hosted customers default to 12 months; we offer a 24-month retention add-on and custom retention via Private deployments.
- Capacity uplift: +40% can be handled via a dedicated capacity reservation; retention change itself doesn’t create technical blocking, but very large log exports will need coordination for egress throughput.

Proposed next steps:
1) Rishi to share a sample audit-log export (sanitized) + short doc on retention options.
2) Monica to deliver SOC2 package and an evidence checklist for your committee.
3) Priyom to prepare a capacity uplift term sheet with pricing and term-extension options (12 vs 24 month).
4) Quick sync next week — 30 min.

Available slots: Mon 2/1 10:00 PT, Tue 2/2 11:30 PT, Wed 2/3 15:00 PT. Let me know what works.

Best,

Hi Taylor — attaching a sanitized sample export of the audit stream and a short ops note on retention options. Key points:

- Attached CSV (audit-log-sample.csv) contains event_type, timestamp, actor, request_id (sanitized), and action. All PII removed.
- Default hosted retention: 12 months. We can upgrade to 24 months as an optional add-on; retention is implemented in tiered cold storage (hot 30d, warm 11 months, cold remainder) so cost scales with active query needs.
- Export/egress: bulk exports over 10GB/day require scheduling and may incur data-transfer charges depending on your region. For your +40% throughput estimate we recommend bumping Dedicated capacity by one slot and enabling streaming export throttle to avoid bursts.
- Timeline for evidence: once we have your PO/commit, Monica can deliver the attestation bundle and a signed letter within 2 business days.

Let me know if you want the raw example in JSON instead of CSV; happy to provide.

-Rishi
